top1.role: Default Theme Park / Chợ Neo main atmosphere loop
top1.reason: Best balance: warm low-brightness profile, strong wave movement, and very stable ending level for repeat use.

runner_up.role: Runner-up / entrance, transition, or alternate park loop
runner_up.reason: More airy and lifted; less aggressive onset profile, shorter than the long Sky Lift variant, better as a usable alternate.
runner_up.original_uploaded_file: Chợ Neo Main Theme - Sky Lift.mp3

implementation_note: Copy these two MP3s into public/Cho_Neo_music. Use top1 as the default Theme Park music; keep runner_up available as an alternate or entrance/transitional track.
